purpose: The worker runtime policy APP2-I02 defined and every deployed worker reads at startup (policy_configurations / policy_configuration_versions, TBL-076 / TBL-077). Until APP12-H03-C1 the only publishers were test fixtures and the APP2-E01 smoke tool, so a cold deployed worker found no policy, reported WORKER_POLICY_MISSING and claimed nothing. Data only: the reader and the publishing caller are APP12-H03-C1, exactly as APP4-G01 and APP6-G01 shipped theirs. No seed runner is introduced here.
idempotency: Upsert by the natural key policy_configurations.config_key (ensureKey), then append one version (publishVersion) only when the key is missing or the stored value has drifted. Versions are immutable; drift is corrected by appending, never by mutating history.

configurations.description: Background worker claim, lease, timeout, shutdown and retry policy (APP2-I02).
